product.name: LINNMON / ADILS desk 150×75
product.note: Simplified guide: dowels, cam locks, nails and screws aren’t shown. Your paper manual shows which to use.

steps.title: First two legs
steps.instruction: Lay the tabletop upside down on the cardboard. Screw two legs into the pre-drilled holes, hand tight.
steps.warning: Hand tight only. Forcing a leg can strip the hole in the tabletop.
checklist: Both legs are screwed in straight and tight

steps.title: Turn it over
steps.instruction: With a second person, lift the desk and turn it onto its legs. Don’t drag it by the legs.
